title: P19: no well-known URI or media type registered
description: §10 registers neither the mimi-protocol-directory well-known URI nor an HTTP media type; server issue; recorded.
notes: 2026-11-02: the well-known half is fixed upstream: ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol#157 (Mark, closed 2026-11-01); the editor's copy registers mimi-protocol-directory per RFC 8615. Host lookup for the directory is a separate gap: mimid-1wgh.37.94.
